files.full_content:
-- Change Log
-- 2026-10-01 補欄位說明
-- account_id: 帳號
-- total_amount: 當日提領合計
SELECT t.account_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount
FROM transactions t
WHERE t.tx_type = 'WITHDRAW'
GROUP BY t.account_id;
